approval_scope: Superseded by sprite study v4 before owner review; retain this version only as provenance, not as the active candidate.

sheet.normalization: uniform 22.6% nearest-neighbor scale per source cell, centered horizontally and bottom-aligned at y=95; no per-frame rescaling

action.motion: twelve distinct connected guard-idle keys: breathing, small hip-weight shifts, hand/arm guard changes, shallow knee compression; no attack, step, jump, or deep crouch
action.weapon_direction: one Zillion pistol in the forward hand, muzzle always facing right
action.continuity: same youthful lean morphology, scale, feet baseline, camera, costume, and equipment in all cells

design_lock: young, lean and agile J.J.; avoid broad or bulky proportions
blue-violet rounded hair; bright magenta-red fitted uniform with high collar
small pale shoulder pads, dark navy diagonal harness and octagonal chest device
belt, one thigh holster, pale forearm guards, rounded knee guards, tall pale boots
exactly one compact Zillion pistol held forward; no second weapon, sword, backpack, cape, vehicle or transformed armor
the Master System game defines identity, palette and game behavior; anime references inform garment construction only as recorded in the approved concept reference boundary
not_claimed: runtime sprite geometry or metasprite validity
